series.overviewDescription: Browse series and their parts. Readers only see published parts whose release time has passed.
series.label: Series
series.createDescription: Bring related articles together and arrange them for your readers.
series.chooseArticlesHint: You can choose articles that do not belong to another series yet.
series.noAvailableArticles: No matching articles without a series were found.
series.orderHint: Use the arrows to change the order of the parts.
series.selectionEmpty: Choose articles from the list or create an empty series and add them later.
series.duplicateName: A series with this name already exists.
series.articlesUnavailable: Some selected articles are no longer available or belong to another series. Refresh your selection and try again.
series.deleteDescription: The articles will be kept and only removed from the series.
